command.name: Burning Ward
verbatim: Odd-numbered Rounds: 25% chance to afflict Stagger on 1 Enemy in any lane for 2 round(s).

Rounds 2, 5, 8: Deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane, prioritizes targets not afflicted with Burn (Damage Rate: +115%). Additionally, there is a 50% chance to afflict the target with Burn for 2 round(s).
At 6+ Stars: Odd-numbered Rounds: increase Burning Ward's chance to afflict Stagger to 50%. Each Round: deal Fire Damage to all Enemies afflicted with a Control effect (Damage Rate: +40%).

vanguard.name: Hunter's Wrath
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase your Fire Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Strength and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Whisper of Ash
verbatim: Start of Round 1: Reduce the Strength and Initiative by -22% (enhanced by Intelligence) of 1 Enemy in the same lane for 5 round(s).
Start of Round 6: Increase your Intelligence and Initiative by +22.4% for 5 round(s).

habits.name: Sunder
habits.verbatim: Start of Each Round: Increase the Damage Received by +10.5% of all enemies afflicted with a Control effect until the end of the round.

habits.name: Gleamstrike
verbatim: Burning Ward gains: Odd-numbered Rounds: Increase the chance to afflict Stagger to 50%.
Each Round: Deal Fire Damage to all Enemies afflicted with a Control effect (Damage Rate: +40%).

habits.name: Gift of Fire
habits.verbatim: Start of Each Round: For each enemy afflicted with Burn, 18% chance to apply Resistance (-15%) to 1 Ally in any lane for 2 round(s) (prioritizes targets not already affected by Resistance).

habits.name: Moonlit Hunt
verbatim: Start of Round 1: Grant yourself Evade for 5 round(s).
Start of Round 6: Increase your Fire Damage Dealt by +12% for 5 round(s).
